title: Maine bridge partially collapses during concrete pour; crews begin dismantling damaged spans
summary_full: Following a tragic collapse on August 13, demolition teams are onsite dismantling the damaged portions of the Llewellyn Estes Bridge, which was under construction over the Stillwater River in Old Town. Several workers sustained injuries during the incident and received urgent medical care. Authorities are launching a comprehensive investigation to uncover the precise reasons behind the failure while prioritizing safety in the preparation for future bridge construction.
